title: Normalized Exact-Money Ledger
description: Shape the bundled auditor (scripts/audit-ledger.mjs) expects. This is a normalization target, not a prescription for the user's own types. Adapt real exports to this shape, or port specific checks against the real types. All money is integer paise (smallest INR unit).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this normalized ledger shape. Integer >= 1.

currency.description: Single currency per ledger. Amounts are integer paise (1/100 INR).

participants.description: People in the ledger. IDs are opaque stable strings; ordering for allocation is by ascending id.

id.description: Opaque stable identifier, unique within the ledger.
Opaque stable expense identifier, unique within the ledger.

payerId.description: Must reference an existing participant id.

amountPaise.description: Positive integer paise. Must stay within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9007199254740991) individually and in aggregate.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not used in money math; carried for completeness.

splitMemberIds.description: Participants sharing this expense equally. Each must reference an existing participant id; no duplicates.
